baseline_models.focus_anchor: The intensive noun نَزَّاعَة is directed by لِـ toward الشَّوَى, joining repeated removal to the body's exposed or nonfatal periphery.
baseline_models.mechanism: Pulling a thing out of its settled place combines with extremities, scalp, and other nonfatal parts to yield iterative dislocation of the bodily perimeter rather than one immediately terminal blow.

activation_trace.role: Pulling something out of its place supplies the forceful, repeated dislodging action of نَزَّاعَة.
Extremities, scalp, and other nonfatal parts supply the affected perimeter and make the action prolonged rather than a single killing strike.

changed_reading.before: A generic remover acting on an obscure object called الشوى.
changed_reading.after: An intensive agent repeatedly strips exposed and peripheral body parts from their places, prolonging bodily unmaking.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same phrase can couple the extraction force of نزع to the heat-processing branch of شوى.
baseline_models.mechanism: The action is not heat alone and not pulling alone: heat changes or loosens material while intensive extraction separates it from where it belongs.

activation_trace.role: Uprooting from a fixed place supplies material separation after cohesion is lost.
Roasting or heating by fire supplies the thermal transformation that enables or accompanies stripping.

changed_reading.before: A purely anatomical pulling-off of extremities.
changed_reading.after: A coupled heat-and-extraction process in which heated matter is repeatedly loosened and stripped from its seat.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: نَزَّاعَة can act upon the شوى branch of remainder, leaving, or sparing.
baseline_models.mechanism: An intensive remover repeatedly takes the portion that had remained, converting apparent residue or respite into the next object of extraction.

activation_trace.role: Removal from place supplies the successive taking of whatever is still present.
A remaining or spared portion supplies the repeatedly renewed object of removal.

changed_reading.before: Damage directed once at a named bodily region.
changed_reading.after: An exhaustive remover that keeps converting every remainder into what is taken next.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sky's molten-material comparison and the mountains' shift from elevated solidity to soft dyed wool scale the focus process upward: coherent mass loses structure, after which heat and pulling can separate its parts.

activation_trace.role: Uprooting from place supplies the final separation of matter whose cohesion has failed.
Heating by fire supplies the local bodily phase change within the larger scene of material instability.
Molten substances and sediment supply a state in which formerly stable material flows or settles.
An elevated solid mass supplies the initial extreme of structural cohesion.
Soft dyed wool supplies the loosened, fibrous end state opposed to mountain solidity.

structural_cues: 70:8-9 pair two similes in sequence: the sky becomes like molten material and mountains become like wool before the focus gives the same loss of integrity a bodily scale.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies molten sky, solid mountains, soft wool, heating, and uprooting; I supply the shared arrow from cohesion through softening to separability. A live alternative is that these are adjacent but independent scenes rather than one material process.

changed_reading.before: Localized thermal damage to bodily parts.
changed_reading.after: The bodily instance of a surah-wide decohesion process in which sky, mountain, and body lose stable form and attachment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The offender tries to detach successive social extensions of himself as substitute bodies; after that substitution is refused, removal recoils inward from sons, spouse, brother, and clan onto his own bodily periphery.

activation_trace.role: Pulling something from its place supplies the detachment first attempted socially and then suffered bodily.
Extremities supply the bodily outer members that remain when substitute social members cannot be offered.
Making one thing a ransom for another supplies the attempted substitution mechanism.
Sonship and descent supply the first, closest extension the offender would sever from himself.
Companionship and abiding together supply a joined relation proposed for detachment.
Brotherhood and kinship widen the set of social members offered in exchange.
The man's clan supplies the enclosing collective body he also tries to surrender.

structural_cues: 70:11-14 expands an additive ransom list from sons through intimate kin and clan to everyone on earth; 70:15 rejects the proposal immediately before 70:16.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a failed substitution list and the focus's extraction of extremities; I supply the recoil from attempted social dismemberment to bodily dismemberment. Alternatively, the kin list may state only desperation while the focus remains strictly anatomical.

changed_reading.before: The fire removes a person's limbs without relation to the preceding ransom speech.
changed_reading.after: What the offender tries to pull away as expendable social limbs returns as stripping of his own bodily limbs.

context_deltas.mechanism: The feminine agent that strips also calls; its call answers prior turning-back and turning-away with an inverse pull, drawing the withdrawing person back until the pull reaches the bodily perimeter.

activation_trace.role: An inward inclination or yearning toward an object supplies the attraction side of the otherwise extractive agent.
The bodily periphery supplies the point at which the recalled person's movement becomes physical stripping.
Calling and inclining by speech supplies the explicit attractive action assigned to the feminine subject.
Turning one's back and withdrawing supplies the first motion that the call reverses.
Turning away supplies a second withdrawal, making the reversal repeated rather than incidental.

structural_cues: 70:17 immediately continues the feminine singular personification and places one calling verb against two coordinated withdrawal verbs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies attraction, calling, and doubled withdrawal; I infer that the call is a directional reversal that recruits the pulling force of نَزَّاعَة. A live alternative is that calling and stripping are separate actions of one personified fire.

changed_reading.before: A force that only pulls body parts outward.
changed_reading.after: A bidirectional captor: it calls the person back from chosen withdrawal, then turns attraction into extraction at the body.

context_deltas.mechanism: Gathering joins dispersed pieces and enclosing secures them inside; intensive removal from place and repeated taking of the remainder perform the exact inverse operations, making the focus agent a counter-container.

activation_trace.role: Extraction from a settled place supplies the reopening and emptying operation.
The remaining or spared portion supplies what enclosure falsely promises to preserve.
Joining dispersed things into one collection supplies the first half of the hoarding mechanism.
Putting a thing into a vessel supplies the closure that extraction reverses.

structural_cues: 70:18 compresses the opposed process into two consecutive perfect verbs, 'gathered, then enclosed,' immediately after the stripping agent calls its target.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies assembly, enclosure, extraction, and remainder; I supply the inverse arrow by which punishment dismantles hoarded containment. Alternatively, wealth-hoarding and bodily stripping may be moral parallels without a shared material mechanism.

changed_reading.before: An exhaustive remover of bodily residue.
changed_reading.after: A counter-hoarding process that reopens what was gathered and sealed, then removes even the portion thought safely retained.

context_deltas.mechanism: The branch of شوى as low-grade property or a small part of a larger whole lets bodily stripping acquire an economic mirror: what the withholding hand treats as negligible is a fixed right, and failure to release it voluntarily is answered by forced extraction.

activation_trace.role: Pulling a thing from its possessor or place supplies involuntary disbursement.
Poor-grade property or a small part from a larger whole supplies the share the possessor may belittle.
Withholding the hand from giving supplies the blocked voluntary release.
Acquiring and multiplying property supplies the larger whole from which a share must leave.
A specific right owned by its holder supplies the share's nonoptional claim.
Questioning and requesting supply one recipient's open claim upon the property.
Deprivation and missing the desired good supply the other recipient's unspoken need.

structural_cues: 70:21 names withholding good; the exception sequence at 70:24-25 answers it with a known right in property for both requester and deprived.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies withholding, accumulated property, a fixed right, two recipients, and the focus branch of slight property; I supply the punitive inversion from voluntary release to forced extraction. The live alternative is that the focus remains anatomical while the property passage is only an ethical contrast.

changed_reading.before: The focus concerns only physical extremities.
changed_reading.after: Bodily stripping mirrors forced disbursement: the minimized share withheld from others is extracted from the one who would not release it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The prayer root carries both specified worship and meeting fire or heat; the exception then qualifies that practice by duration and guarding. This creates a contrast between sustained, bounded contact that preserves order and unbounded heat-contact that strips matter apart.

activation_trace.role: Uprooting from place supplies the disintegrative result of destructive exposure.
Roasting and heating by fire supply the uncontrolled thermal pole of the contrast.
Meeting fire and its heat supplies a lexical bridge between the exempt group and the focus's thermal process.
Specified worship supplies the enacted practice named for the exempt group.
Stillness and continuity supply sustained rather than spasmodic practice.
Adhering to and maintaining an undertaking supplies the practice's protective boundary.

structural_cues: 70:22 opens an exception, while 70:23 and 70:34 frame the long ethical list by describing prayer first as continuous and finally as guarded.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the prayer/fire branch overlap plus continuity and guarding; I infer a contrast between disciplined and destructive contact with heat. A live alternative is ordinary polysemy with no mechanistic relation between worship and fire-contact.

changed_reading.before: The focus is an isolated image of destructive fire.
changed_reading.after: It is the unbounded pole of a heat-contact contrast: destructive exposure strips coherence, while continuous guarded practice preserves it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The origin-drawing branch of نزع turns stripping into decomposition of a created composite; the remnant branch of شوى then meets the declared capacity to replace one creation with another, a process the targets cannot outrun.

activation_trace.role: Being drawn back to origin or stock supplies decomposition as a return rather than mere surface injury.
A remnant of what has been destroyed supplies the residual state from which replacement becomes imaginable.
Bringing a creation into existence supplies the composite whose form can be undone.
One thing standing in another's place supplies replacement after decomposition.
Escaping a pursuer supplies the explicitly denied possibility of outrunning the replacement process.

structural_cues: 70:39 points to the material of their creation; 70:41 states both replacement by others and the impossibility of getting beyond the actor's reach.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies origin-drawing, remnants, creation, replacement, and denied escape; I supply the arrow that stripping decomposes the present form before substitution. Alternatively, creation and replacement may demonstrate power without describing the focus's physical sequence.

changed_reading.before: A punishment that damages the body's exterior.
changed_reading.after: A recall of the created composite toward source material, exposing its replaceability rather than merely injuring its surface.

context_deltas.mechanism: A نزع branch of surging forward reorients the focus from static removal to compelled vector: bodies come out of graves, rush on their extremities toward an erected target, and are overtaken by an overpowering state.

activation_trace.role: Surging forward in running supplies the kinetic branch hidden inside the intensive focus form.
Feet, limbs, and other extremities supply the bodily machinery of the compelled rush.
Passing to the outside supplies the launch of bodily movement from confinement.
The grave supplies the fixed enclosure from which the bodies emerge.
Speed as the opposite of slowness supplies the pace of the extracted bodies.
An erected, conspicuous object supplies the movement's visible endpoint.
Overtaking and overpowering supply the compulsion that governs the rush rather than voluntary haste.

structural_cues: 70:43 presents a single rapid path from graves toward a نصب; 70:44 immediately overlays that movement with downcast sight and engulfing humiliation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies forward-surging, emergence, graves, speed, a goal, and overpowering; I infer that the pulling force of the focus also commandeers the extremities as motion. Alternatively, the stripping at 70:16 and the resurrection rush at 70:43 are separate phases with no shared vector.

changed_reading.before: A stationary agent removes limbs from a stationary victim.
changed_reading.after: A force-vector that pulls bodies out, drives their extremities into a rush, and ends in overpowering exposure.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it hears نَزَّاعَة as an archer's draw rather than ordinary extraction. It remains anchored by the focus inventory's bowstring branch and the شوى branch that explicitly includes striking nonfatal parts with a shot, while 70:6-7 supplies the far/near trajectory. Render it only as a projectile-like secondary activation, not as the lexical replacement for the anatomical reading.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The bowstring branch of نزع and the shot-sensitive extremity branch of شوى converge inside the two-word focus phrase.

activation_trace.role: Drawing a bowstring supplies stored tension and launch rather than simple pulling-off.
Extremities and nonfatal places struck by a shot supply the projectile's target zone.
Distance from nearness supplies the target's perceived remoteness before release.
Nearness opposed to distance supplies the imminent arrival or impact after the draw.

changed_reading.before: A remover already in contact with the body.
changed_reading.after: An archer-like force whose draw collapses apparent distance into impact at exposed bodily parts.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is unexpectedly specific because a peripheral lexical branch of نزع names receding hair at the forehead, while شوى includes the head and scalp. The convergence is entirely focus-anchored, but it should qualify a scalp-exposure reading rather than claim that the intensive form lexically means a receding hairline here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Both focus roots independently converge on the forehead, hairline, head, or scalp region.

activation_trace.role: Recession of hair at the temples supplies a concrete image of the frontal covering pulled back.
The head and scalp among the extremities supply the anatomical location exposed by that recession image.

changed_reading.before: Generic removal of skin or limbs anywhere on the body.
changed_reading.after: A concentrated image of frontal and scalp exposure, as though the body's covering is driven back from its visible edge.

strongest_changes: The molten-sky and wool-mountain sequence scales heat-assisted stripping into a common process of cosmic and bodily decohesion.
Gathering and enclosing at 70:18 make the focus agent a counter-container that reopens hoarded matter and removes the remainder.
Withholding, property, fixed right, requester, and deprived turn the low-grade-property branch of شوى into a forced-release mirror of bodily stripping.
Creation and replacement activate نزع as return to origin, recasting surface injury as decomposition of a replaceable created form.
summary.what_was_special: Both focus roots bifurcated productively: نزع supplied extraction, attraction, return to origin, bow-drawing, and forward surge, while شوى supplied extremities, heating, low-grade property, and remainder. Context organized these branches as reversals of withdrawal, substitution, enclosure, withholding, and created form without forcing them into one final reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus is a grammatical fragment whose rootless subject appears in 70:15, so some branch activations may be resonances rather than the semantic scope of الشوى.
The prayer/fire-contact and compelled-motion readings depend on cross-domain arrows supplied by the reader and remain exploratory.
The kin-ransom and due-share models may be moral juxtapositions rather than literal causal descriptions of the stripping process.
